name: Excel Spreadsheet Generator
description: Generate XLSX spreadsheets with formulas, styling, charts, and conditional formatting using openpyxl. Supports Arabic RTL sheets, CJK, and Russian. Output saved to the workspace.
short_description: Create Excel workbooks with formulas, formatting, and RTL sheets.
store_description: Creates .xlsx workbooks using openpyxl. Handles formulas (=SUM, =VLOOKUP, =IF), cell styling (fonts, fills, borders, number formats), column widths, merged cells, images, and conditional formatting. Supports right-to-left worksheets for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Urdu. Always verifies the output file before reporting success.

examples.description: Create a sales report with formulas
examples.expected_outcome: An XLSX with headers, styled cells, =SUM totals, and a bar chart saved as sales.xlsx.

examples.context: User provides product names and quantities in Arabic.
examples.expected_outcome: A right-to-left XLSX with Arabic headers, RTL number format, and conditional highlighting for low stock.

examples.context: User provides a category table and an expense log.
examples.expected_outcome: A two-sheet XLSX: categories + expenses, with =VLOOKUP pulling category names into the expense sheet.
